reason: An interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness agents, providing chat, planning, approvals, session management, and access to the composed shell and filesystem tool ecosystem.

summaries.zh: 通过终端提供 DeepSeek Harness 智能体的交互式聊天界面，支持流式输出、工具调用审批、计划审查和会话恢复。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal chat interface for DeepSeek Harness agents with streaming output, tool-call approvals, plan review, and session resumption.

capabilities: Interactive terminal chat interface for DeepSeek Harness agents
Streaming model output and reasoning display
Access to the composed shell and filesystem tool ecosystem
Session resume, compaction, and context-status management
